T2.title: Table 2: Definitions of forecaster characteristics

cells.original_display: Full name of the forecaster as listed in the SPF acknowledgement panel.
Gender inferred based on publicly available information (e.g., name, social media).
The institution or company the forecaster is associated with (e.g., university, bank).
Type of organization the forecaster works for, such as academic, financial, forecasting center, government, etc.
The forecaster's job title or role when the forecast was made (e.g., professor, economist).
The highest degree the forecaster has earned (e.g., Bachelor, Master, PhD).
The field of study for the forecaster's degree (e.g., Economics, Finance).
The year the forecaster completed their highest degree, used to estimate experience and age.
The institution where the forecaster earned their highest degree.
The geographic location of the forecaster’s affiliated institution or company.
Whether the forecaster gives public interviews or engages with media (yes/no).
Whether the forecaster has a public Twitter profile (yes/no).

T2.calculation_note: Characteristic definitions transcribed from the manuscript; classifications are not independently validated.
